majors.target: wasteland_ruins dirt base (dirt-a..d) / all 6 wasteland maps
majors.issue: Ground repeats on an exact 64px lattice: the dark pits and streak patches recur at fixed positions. In g-dirt-field2x the 64px shift difference is 95 against a variance of 612, so the copies are almost identical. The same 64px lattice is the strongest period on settlement-1 and shanty-3. The four dirt variants are 93-98% pixel-identical (the same base with a few decals), so mixing them does not break the repeat. The base is also flat single-pixel blue-grey salt-and-pepper speckle with no clustered forms. Beodeul grass or modern-city pavement reads better.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-B/dirtfield.png (pits at x~225/735/1055/1380 on a 64px grid); /tmp/vqa-r2-B/sh3.png (open ground between shacks)
majors.fix: Redraw the dirt with larger clustered value shapes, remove the per-pixel blue specks, and give each variant a different base, not just decals. Put the dark pits/patches on a non-tiling decal layer or a >=4-variant random fill so no 64px lattice survives.

majors.issue: The road fill is a uniform knit/zigzag texture with a hard 16px horizontal period (32px vertical). At 1x, every road reads as patterned fabric or chain mail rather than cracked asphalt. There is no curb, shoulder, lane paint, crack or patch variation along long runs, which is much busier than the Beodeul cobble road in wl-compare-3x.
majors.fix: Use a calmer two-tone asphalt with sparse cracks, potholes and faded lane-paint decals that break the 16px period, and add a broken edge/shoulder strip against the dirt.

majors.issue: The two settlements are the same template mirrored. Both have one cross-shaped road, a row of ruined blocks at the top and a walled compound with a bunker-module top wall and column side walls. Inside, both have 3-4 tin shacks, a slab plaza with two market stalls, a campfire and logs, two water towers, solar panels and a generator. A player would read these as the same map.
majors.fix: Vary the compound shape (L-shaped, round or partial palisade), its position relative to the roads, the road topology and the building mix per seed.

majors.issue: The top wall is 7 identical bunker stamps in a row (the same window and brick patch on each), with an unexplained gap in the middle. The side walls are separate thin column pieces that do not join the corner bunkers. The bottom of the compound is completely open, so the 'wall' has no defensive logic and looks toy-like.
majors.fix: Build the wall from a proper wall autotile (scrap, barricade or jersey barrier) with corners and a gate opening, and use the bunker stamp at most once as a guard post.

majors.issue: Repeated identical stamps and overlaps. Six identical rubble mounds sit in two rows of three, and several straddle the edge of the concrete slab plate (half on slab, half on dirt). A bunker sits half off its slab. In ruined-city-2 the domed car-wreck stamp appears 4+ times, identical and lined up along the road. The slab plates are hard grey rectangles pasted on dirt with no rubble or dirt edge transition.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-B/rc5-mid.png (mounds at top row and mid row); /tmp/vqa-r2-B/rc2-bot.png (wrecks on road and on slab); /tmp/vqa-r2-B/rc2-mid.png (mound over slab corner)
majors.fix: Limit identical stamps per block, keep props wholly on or off slabs, and add a broken slab-edge autotile, i.e. crumbled concrete fading into dirt.

majors.issue: The flagstone temple yard is the same stamp in both maps. It has an identical object layout: a small shrine top-left, a pediment temple in the centre, two pairs of columns, a wall chunk on the left, a cypress on the right and the same debris pieces at the same relative positions (translated by -208,-128). The 'ruins' also read as tidy and intact (standing temple, unbroken columns, pristine rectangular flagstone with a curb), not as ancient ruins.
majors.fix: Generate the plaza contents per seed. Use broken or fallen columns, partial temple walls, missing flagstones with grass breaking through, and an irregular yard outline that dissolves into grass.

majors.target: Beodeul maps: forest blocks (temple-ruins-5, mining-7, also temple-ruins-2 / mining-2 right edges)
majors.issue: Forest canopy masses are cut along straight vertical and horizontal lines. You can see half-trees clipped mid-crown, black void gaps between crowns and grass showing through square notches. This is the classic 'half-cut trees' defect, and it is very visible at 1x.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-B/t5-forest.png (left edge stair-cuts and x~85-130 clipped crowns); /tmp/vqa-r2-B/m7-yard.png (right-hand forest block, straight cut at x~820-870 in crop)
majors.fix: Place whole tree stamps only, giving the forest edge an organic outline of complete crowns, and fill the interior gaps with canopy, not void.

majors.issue: Both mining villages have three identical log-cabin stamps in a row. Apart from the single dirt yard with a derrick and mine entrance, the villages are generic farm/forest maps with no spoil heaps, carts, tracks or tailings. They do not read strongly as a mining town, and the two seeds have nearly the same building set.
majors.fix: Vary the house stamps or variants, and add mining-specific props along the road from the yard (ore carts on rails, spoil heaps, timber stacks, a miners' row).

minors.issue: Every slab joint intersection has the same brown dirt blob, so the joints read as a regular dotted pattern. In g-slab-field1x the whole layout repeats exactly every 128px (diff 150 vs var 1372), which is visible in large plazas.
minors.fix: Randomise the joint decals and offset the slab courses between variants.

minors.issue: The two vine-row blocks are the same stamp, with the identical missing-plant gap and the yellow end post in the same cell.
minors.fix: Mirror or vary the vine blocks, or build them from row pieces.

minors.target: Beodeul grass under all quarter villages
minors.issue: At zoom, a faint light glyph-like motif repeats regularly in the grass, readable as a watermark pattern.
minors.fix: Check the grass variant mix; it is pre-existing but visible next to the new yards.

minors.issue: Yard outlines are stepped rectangles with blocky notches, e.g. the m7 bottom-left and m2 left side. The grass fringe is good, but the overall shape still reads as a pasted rectangle.
A green debug square or spawn marker is baked into the render near the left edge.
minors.fix: Hide the start marker in QA renders.

minors.issue: Both shanty towns use the same straight top road and a loose grid of the same 4 shack stamps. There are no paths between shacks, so the layout reads as random scatter rather than an improvised town.
minors.fix: Add worn foot paths, clusters around a well or fire, and fences or tarps linking shacks.

minors.issue: Its silhouette is close to the steampunk water tower (round tank on a trestle with a side ladder), only recoloured rust.
minors.fix: Make it more improvised, e.g. a patched barrel tank on a scaffold.

minors.issue: Near-black navy blobs with almost no highlight read as holes or oil rather than water.
minors.fix: Add a sky reflection highlight and a muddy rim.
